description: OpenSCAD variant renderer with PNG/STL output, gallery and slicer slots.
pre_uninstall: $root = Split-Path $dir -Parent; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='SCADRenderer.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -like "$root\*" } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'tray-host|scad-tray' -and $_.CommandLine -like "*$root*" } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SCAD Render Tray' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\SystemFileAssociations\.scad\shell\SCADRender' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($p in 'scad-viewer','scad-gallery','scad-slot','scad-slicer','scad-embed'){ Remove-Item ('HKCU:\Software\Classes\' + $p) -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\SCAD Render.lnk') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
